title: Vecs Speak 512k AI
description: Vecs_Speak_512k is a simple artificial intelligence for Minecraft, implemented as a datapack.
body:
Vecs_Speak_512k is a simple artificial intelligence for Minecraft, implemented as a datapack.
It allows you to ask text questions directly in the game and receive answers related to Minecraft.
Works without mods and without an internet connection.

## Features and limitations:

- Answers questions related to Minecraft (mechanics, history, basic guides).
- Fast response time, around 2 seconds on average.
- Fully offline operation.
- All functionality is contained within a single datapack.
- May make mistakes if there are typos in the query.
- Does not work well with questions unrelated to Minecraft.

## CPU compatibility:

- Will struggle on: old Intel i3 CPUs and mobile U-series processors.
- Minimum required: AMD Ryzen 3 / Intel i3 10th generation.
- Recommended: AMD Ryzen 5 / Intel i5 and above.

## Installation:

1. Copy the datapack "[DataPack] Vecs_Speak_512k.zip" into the datapacks folder of your world.
2. Enter the world or reload it using the /reload command.
3. After the datapack is loaded, the AI is ready to use.
